properties.evidence: The mechanism is known and was exercised in both directions on the reporter's own file, which is what makes this `causal` rather than `correlational`: dynograph-core inserts any missing property declaring a `default:` at write time (schema.rs:507), so import materialised granularity/volatility onto all 35 of music_graph's Artifacts. Removing the two `default:` tokens and re-running the same import -> re-export gave 0 changed nodes; restoring them gave 35 again. The shipped gate agrees — reflow2_check.py against their export dropped its ROUND TRIP finding, 5 findings -> 4.
